finding.headline: "The Nigerian Immunisation Maze"
finding.problem: "UNICEF has a schedule but the clinic gave me a different card. Which is right? If I miss BCG/OPV my baby is at risk and I'll be the bad mother."
finding.person: Nigerian mum (local) confused by the national immunisation schedule; fears missing a dose.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.
